article.headline: Bucks visit Pistons Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Milwaukee Bucks (2-17, 15th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Detroit Pistons (11-6, fifth in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Bucks visit Pistons Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Bucks visit Pistons Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Milwaukee Bucks (2-17, 15th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Detroit Pistons (11-6, fifth in the Eastern Conference) Detroit; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Milwaukee Bucks travel to play the Milwaukee Bucks in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Pistons are 0-0 against division opponents. Detroit ranks third in the Eastern Conference at limiting opponent scoring, giving up only 107.2 points while holding opponents to 43.9% shooting. The Bucks are 1-2 against Central Division opponents. Milwaukee is 0-1 in one-possession games. The Pistons are shooting 46.7% from the field this season, 0.3 percentage points higher than the 46.4% the Bucks allow to opponents. The Bucks are shooting 43.6% from the field, 0.3% lower than the 43.9% the Pistons' opponents have shot this season. TOP PERFORMERS: Ausar Thompson is shooting 55.2% and averaging 10.8 points for the Pistons. Cade Cunningham is averaging 19.7 points over the last 10 games. Tyler Herro is averaging 22.3 points and 4.6 assists for the Bucks. Kyle Kuzma is averaging 2.1 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Pistons: 5-5, averaging 113.5 points, 42.0 rebounds, 27.9 assists, 9.2 steals and 5.2 blocks per game while shooting 46.6% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 112.1 points per game. Bucks: 1-9, averaging 108.5 points, 41.9 rebounds, 23.6 assists, 8.2 steals and 4.9 blocks per game while shooting 43.8% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 118.5 points. INJURIES: Pistons: Jalen Duren: out (hamstring), Ebuka Okorie: day to day (oblique), Taurean Prince: out (knee), Duncan Robinson: out (quadriceps), Cade Cunningham: day to day (knee). Bucks: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
